messages:
Ana Ruiz: Quick note — Riverside Dev Meetup next Thurs 6pm. Booth is compact: 1 table, 2 chairs, no power guaranteed. We need final speaker list, swag split, and lead capture flow by EOD Tue.

Jon Park: I can own lead capture. Plan: QR -> short Google Form -> Airtable. Include interest tags API/Dedicated/Private.

Priya Nair: Speakers: 3 confirmed (Redwood intro, cost case, community demo). One lightning slot open. Asking for 1-slide demo + 1-line bio by Wed noon.

Evan Chen: Swag: 70 tees, 80 stickers, 50 enamel pins. Vendor can drop day-of at 2pm. Need onsite name for handoff.

LogisticsBot: dock_reservation: confirmed for Riverside venue, Dock A, Thu 14:00-15:00. Driver to ping #events-on-site when arriving.

BannerCo: We'll ship a 4ft roll-up banner. Please confirm artwork file name and delivery address.

Ana Ruiz: Art file is riverside-banner-v3.pdf. Delivery to 210 Riverside Dr, Loading Zone A. Onsite contact: Ivy (events) 917-555-0301.

Ivy (events): AV note: no wired ethernet. Bring hotspot + battery. Also venue disallows tape on floors — bring cable covers.

Jon Park: I'll bring a hotspot, a power bank, and cable covers. Also will create the form and share link by Tue 5pm.

Priya Nair: Run-of-show draft:
```
18:00 doors
18:20 Welcome (Ana) 5m
18:26 Redwood intro (Priya) 10m
18:38 Community demo (speaker) 8m
18:47 Lightning (open) 5m
18:55 Networking at booth
```
Speakers please confirm slides by Wed noon.

Evan Chen: Photographer? Recommend 30 mins for setup + 1 talk. Budget ok up to $120.

Ana Ruiz: Approve $120 for photographer. Final checklist for Tue EOD: slides, form live, dock confirmed, banner delivery confirmed. Reply with :thumbsup: if you own an item.

Jon Park: :thumbsup: owning form + hotspot.

Priya Nair: :thumbsup: chasing slides.

Evan Chen: :thumbsup: handling swag handoff and photographer booking.

Ana Ruiz: Thanks team 680. Will post run-of-show on Wed AM.
